title: Attribute-bound RBAC v2 and KMS provenance mediator with tenant consent orchestrator
author: Leah Park
description:
Motivation: Customers requested stronger guarantees that KMS operations and audit headers are only allowed when tenant attributes (region, residency_class, and consent flags) align with key provenance. This PR implements an attribute-bound RBAC v2 guard and a lightweight KMS provenance mediator that validates KMS selection and injects immutable audit claims.

What this PR does (single-string summary):
- Introduces an attribute-fencing policy layer for RBAC v2 that evaluates explicit tenant attributes in the request context (tenant.region, tenant.residency_class, tenant.opt_in_kms_consent). Policies are declarative YAML under rbac_v2/policies/attribute_fence/*.yaml.
- Adds kms/provenance-mediator service: verifies candidate KMS provider locations against tenant attributes and signs a short-lived provenance token that downstream services must present to perform key operations.
- Adds an enforcement shim in the API gateway that rejects key-use when provenance token and tenant attributes mismatch, and emits sealed audit headers.
- Adds migration script to convert a subset of legacy role bindings to attribute-aware templates.

Design highlights and examples:
- Policy example (rbac_v2/policies/attribute_fence/tenant_region.yaml):
  condition: "request.attributes.tenant.region == resource.kms_region && request.attributes.tenant.opt_in_kms_consent == true"
- Provenance mediator: signs provenance token with service KMS and attaches header "X-KMS-Provenance" and an immutable audit tag "x-rrw-audit-tenant". Downstream services validate token expiry and the included kms_region claim.
- Fallback behavior: if tenant.opt_in_kms_consent is false, requests to region-mismatched KMS will be rejected with 403 and a clear error code (ERR_KMS_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH).

Checklist:
- [x] Spec and design doc (Linear: ENG-4217) attached
- [x] Unit tests for attribute evaluator and policy loader
- [x] Integration test that exercises mediator + gateway enforcement (flaky in CI, rerun passed)
- [x] Migration tool with dry-run mode
- [x] Docs: security/rbac/attribute-fence.md and operator notes in private-installer/README.md

Testing & rollout plan:
- Canary rollout using feature flag: rbac.attribute_fence.enabled per region. Start with US-East non-production, validate audit spikes and latency under load.
- Monitor metrics: kms.provenance.validation.latency, rbac.attribute_evaluator.failures, audit.forwarder.drop_rate. Default alert thresholds added to observability-pack dashboards.
- Rollback: disable feature flag, gateway rejects are replaced by permissive allow if in audit-only mode.

Backward compatibility and security impact:
- Backwards compatible by default (attribute_fence disabled). When enabled for a tenant, any mismatch causes explicit denial — this is a functional change for those tenants who opt in. Security posture improved by preventing accidental cross-region KMS use.

Migration notes:
- Migration script (tools/migrations/convert-bindings-attribute-aware.py) lists candidate bindings and can run in dry-run to produce a Linear ticket for manual approval.

References: ENG-4217, ENG-4389, SUP-1223.

review_comments: Diego Marquez (review): The attribute checker looks good; please add a unit test for null tenant.region and ensure the policy loader rejects policies without explicit 'condition' field.

Author (Leah Park): Added null handling tests and a validation pass for missing condition. See commit 3rd. Also added a short note in docs that missing attributes produce explicit denies when enforcement is enabled.
Sofia Chen (review): Concern about latency — mediator adds an extra roundtrip. Can we cache provenance tokens per request window?

Author (Leah Park): Implemented a short-lived token cache (60s) keyed by (tenant_id, kms_region). Added metrics kms.provenance.cache.hit/miss and baseline numbers to observability dashboard. See commit 'perf: cache provenance tokens'.
Omar Hassan (security review): Approve after you sign the mediator image and add a small e2e asserting that the gateway rejects mismatched region with correct audit header.
Author (Leah Park): Added image signature verification step in the CI stage and the e2e. CI flake occurred on integration test; reran and it passed.
release_notes: Adds opt-in attribute-bound RBAC policies and a KMS provenance mediator that prevents cross-region key use when tenant attributes do not match. Introduces audit headers for non-repudiation and a migration tool to convert role bindings to attribute-aware templates. Disabled by default; enable via feature flag per-tenant.
security_impact: high: enforces tenant-region constraints on KMS usage when enabled; reduces risk of cross-region data exposure. Requires operator review before enabling for production tenants.
notes: Feature gated and documented. Observability and rollback procedures included. CI showed one flaky integration test that was rerun and is now stable.
